title: Claude wasn't good enough with the facial expressions so I have been trying out new styles with GPT Astra.
author: ForkedPush
selftext:
Which one do you like?

There is also a poll up on my X if you want to vote there: [https://x.com/ForkedPush/status/2117939741043871960?a=jLkGReCvXsm-GpOMQ24&s=20](https://x.com/ForkedPush/status/2117939741043871960?a=jLkGReCvXsm-GpOMQ24&s=20)

comments.author: Emergency-Radish-682
comments.body: L'original correspond bien au style du perso je trouve

replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: Thank you, as a dev I am really confused. I am getting a lot of complaints about the original. But whenever I change it they say original was better. I wonder if anyone is having the same problem when developing their games.

replies.author: Emergency-Radish-682
replies.body: T'inquiète t'auras toujours des personnes aigris

replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: I gave references from popular anime shows to astra. They are all like this. Or you mean the gap between eyes?

comments.author: hateborne
comments.body: The original gives me a more unique feel. It also has a slight One Punch Man level of detail, which I find hilarious

comments.author: Kill4meat
comments.body: You are overthinking. None of these are bad; matter of preference. I like A and D the most.
